entries.title: II Chronicles 5:2
segments:
Zion; in the south-west part of Jerusalem, and south-west from Moriah, the site of the temple. 
 
When a whole people assemble, and with united hearts engage sincerely in the worship of God, they may expect that their service will be acceptable to him and greatly beneficial to themselves.

entries.title: II Chronicles 5:3
segments: The feast which was in the seventh month; the feast of tabernacles, which was celebrated in the month of Tishri, corresponding to the last part of September and the first part of October.

entries.title: II Chronicles 5:7
segments: The cherubim; the two cherubim of olive-wood over laid with gold.

entries.title: II Chronicles 5:9
segments: Unto this day; see note to

entries.title: II Chronicles 5:10
segments:
The two tables; on which were engraved the ten commandments. 
 
The ten commandments express the will of God, and are the measure and the rule of human duty, under all dispensations, and in all ages.

entries.title: II Chronicles 5:13
segments: When the ministers of religion heartily unite in praising and adoring God for his mercies, he will accept their offerings, and give evidence of his approbation by delightful manifestations of his presence and favor.
